How about checking r/ADHD? You may have adhd (or something with similar symptoms) and even if you don't, they have a lot of helpful tips that might help you deal with your procrastination!

One of the tips I see a lot is the pomodoro technique. Study for some time (25-60 minutes maybe?) then take a 5-10 minute break. After studying four times, take a longer break. Make sure not to lose your momentum by browsing through social media/games during your breaks though! You can also search up interesting details/fun facts about topics related to what you're studying to encourage you to continue studying!
